institution.name: Academy for Nursing and Health Occupations

plan.notes: Source: Academy for Nursing and Health Occupations official website, Associate of Science Degree in Nursing (Professional/RN) program page, hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Stated program totals: 96 weeks; 59 theory + 2 lab + 11 clinical = 72 semester credit hours. All 16 listed courses sum to exactly 72 (theory subtotal 59, lab 2, clinical 11), matching the stated total. Catalog does NOT publish a term-by-term map; the program is described as linear, so the 6 terms below are an editorial sequencing derived strictly from the catalog's prerequisite chains. Prereqs are transcribed from the catalog's Pre-requisite Courses lists; the catalog prints 'ENC101 College Writing' in prereq lists, which refers to the program's ENC1101 College Writing course (recorded as ENC1101). For NUR2212 the catalog prints 'NUR1023/NUR1204L Healthcare Essentials and Healthcare Essentials Skills' - NUR1204L appears nowhere else in the program; it is almost certainly a typo for NUR1024L, the course's own skills-lab code, and is recorded as NUR1024L.

courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'BSC2086 Anatomy & Physiology - 4 Semester Credit Hrs. Includes BSC2086L - Anatomy & Physiology Lab'. Theory 3.0 + Lab 1.
